headlines.title: Why Verisk (VRSK) shares are trading lower today
headlines.summary: Shares of insurance data analytics provider Verisk Analytics (NASDAQ:VRSK) fell 3.7% in the afternoon session after the company reported third-quarter results that were close to estimates. Its full-year earnings outlook was a bit light.

headlines.title: What Verisk Analytics (VRSK) Said on Its Q3 Earnings Call
headlines.summary: Verisk Analytics (NASDAQ:VRSK) reported higher third-quarter revenue and adjusted earnings per share as subscription growth and stronger-than-expected transactional revenue helped offset pressure from lighter weather activity and softer property insurance markets.

headlines.title: Verisk (VRSK) Stock Looks Below Fair Value Despite Its 28% Run
headlines.summary: Verisk Analytics has surged over the past month, which puts a fresh spotlight on a simple question for anyone looking at the stock today. Are the cash flows from Verisk’s information services strong and durable enough to support where the share price now trades? The share price has climbed 28.0% over the past month, so a lot now depends on whether the current valuation is still grounded in the stream of cash the business can generate.

headlines.title: Verisk Stock Earnings Beat Has The Bull Case Changed?
headlines.summary: Verisk Analytics reported Q3 2026 revenue of US$809 million and net income of US$219.2 million, with adjusted earnings per share of US$1.96 exceeding analyst expectations and subscription activity highlighted as a key driver. The business leaned heavily on AI-powered insurance tools and a capital return program that included a US$100 million accelerated share repurchase and a higher dividend, underlining how data products and cash returns now work together in Verisk’s model.

headlines.title: Verisk Analytics (VRSK) Earnings Beat Puts Its Pricey Narrative Back In Focus
headlines.summary: Verisk Analytics (VRSK) has put fresh numbers on the table, reporting third quarter 2026 sales of US$809 million and net income of US$219.2 million, giving investors updated insight into the insurance data specialist. The fresh earnings beat appears to have reset sentiment around Verisk Analytics, with a 1-day share price return of 6.88% and a 30-day share price return of 28.01% at US$211.47. However, the year-to-date share price return is down 4.

description: Verisk Analytics, Inc. engages in the provision of data analytics and technology solutions to the insurance industry in the United States and internationally. The company offers underwriting solutions, including forms, rules, and loss costs services that provides policy language, prospective loss costs, policy writing and rating rules, and underwriting solutions for risk selection and segmentation, pricing, and workflow optimization; underwriting data and analytics solutions, which provides property and auto specific rating, and underwriting information solutions; catastrophe modelling and risk solutions; life insurance solutions for transforming current workflows in life insurance underwriting, claim insights, policy administration, unclaimed property/equity, compliance and fraud detection, and actuarial and portfolio modelling; specialty business solutions, which provides full end-to-end management of insurance and reinsurance business; and international underwriting solutions. It also provides claims insurance solutions, including property estimating solutions, provide data, analytics, and networking solutions for professionals involved in estimating all phases of building repair and reconstruction; anti-fraud solutions that provide fraud-detection tools for the property and casualty insurance industry; casualty solutions, which focus on compliance, casualty claims decision, and workflow automation; and international claims solutions, which focus on personal injury and motor franchises with complementary offerings to the property claims solutions. The company was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey.
